title: Arena of Nîmes
geometryBasis: The native outer and inner rings and the monument operator’s overall measured dimensions control the elliptical geometry, referenced to the French bare-earth heightfield.
sectionBasis: Rijksmuseum nineteenth-century imagery establishes the two open arcades, round-head bays and engaged shaft profiles. The City of Nîmes reports four seating sections and 34 rows. The remaining modern monument is represented with simplified masonry repairs.
limitations: Individual Roman repairs, reliefs and restored stone profiles are simplified. The interior circulation beyond the open outer bays and the detailed subterranean complex are outside the exterior model.
Seating row placement and heights are interpreted between documented section sizes. Modern temporary event fixtures and crowds are omitted.
